steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ summary; the case specifies an existing event.
Enable the required eRFX project capability before accessing the event flow.
Navigate to the RFQ stage page where the stage Settings menu is available.
Open the RFQ Settings menu and choose Recreate Order.
Verify the Recreate Order pop-up opened and shows its Product Sheet option.
Verify the recreated-order options are present in the pop-up.
Verify the pop-up includes Delivery Date.
Verify the scheduling choice is present in the pop-up.
Choose the path that should open the complete editable create screen.
Confirm the full event create screen opened.
Verify the recreated screen has a template already applied.
Verify the prepared RFQ's line item was carried into the recreated create screen.
Verify the copied pricing sheet rendered with the expected RFQ columns.
